label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
Hi Renee, this is the owner of Lotus Garden. First, I am very sorry your toe hurts. I really mean it. You have been our customer 2 years, and I never want anyone to leave my salon and end up in pain.

I want to tell you what happened from our side. I will stay calm, because I think you deserve to hear it straight and not through other people.

On Saturday Oct 24 you had the deluxe pedicure, $45, with my niece Vy. She is licensed 3 years. She was born and raised in Houston and her English is fine. She is just a little shy. During the pedicure you asked her to cut the cuticle more, and she said not too much. You told her it was fine, that you always do it like that. I am not saying this to blame you. I only want to say what was talked about in the chair.

About cleaning: every metal tool comes out of the autoclave in a sealed pouch, and we open it in front of the customer. The file and buffer are new for each person, and you took yours home. There is a new plastic liner in the tub every time. Our state inspection was in August this year. We passed with no violations, and the paper is on our wall.

When you came back on Nov 2 and showed me your toe, I offered you the full $45 back, plus I would pay your urgent care copay if you bring the receipt. You asked for $300 cash and free pedicures for a year, and I could not do that. I am sorry if it felt like I shrugged at you. That was not my meaning. My offer is still open today.

You said you filed with the state. That is your right, and we will help them any way they ask. We have nothing to hide.

To the people reading: I opened this salon in 2007 after working for my aunt, and that is 19 years in Houston. In all that time we never had an infection complaint. I am not asking anyone to just believe me. But it hurt a lot to read that all nail salons are dirty. We are not all the same, and my family works very hard to keep this place clean. Vy read this thread and cried all night, and now she says she wants to leave nails. She is young and she did nothing wrong that I can see.

Marisol, thank you for speaking up so kindly. You were fair to Renee and fair to us, and it means a lot to me.

Renee, please call the salon and ask for me, or come in and sit down with me. I would much rather talk face to face than on a forum. You are still a customer I care about. I hope your toe heals fast.
